item: Pageview top-up waits for an unpublished day; a halted lane reads as halted
key_paths: src/wiki/pageviews.py src/wiki/service.py src/scheduler/settings.py src/monitoring/soak_window.py src/api/scheduler.py tests/test_wiki_pageviews_not_published.py tests/test_wiki_lane_halt_recorded.py
summary: Row 72: asked for yesterday before Wikimedia published it, the top-up got a 404 and asked again every drain (114 warnings on one machine). fetch_top now names a 404 NotPublishedYet; the service keeps the list it holds, records the wait and asks that day again after an hour, logging once at INFO; every other failure still raises and is reported. Row 73: a lane halted for days read as 0 rows a day and no gap. A settings save that changes wiki_lane_state now records when and through which door (settings-save or the damaged-settings replacement, which writes halted); the soak reading publishes the held-off stretch as service.not_running and beside gaps, and the scheduler status carries state_change. A halt is not written as a versioned_gaps row: a resume continues from the cursor and a real hole is recorded then as retention. A halt older than this record reads as not recorded, never guessed.
